name: Usama Tahir
shortBio: Usama Tahir holds a BS in Media and Communication from the University of Sargodha, where he graduated in 2026.
bio: Usama Tahir holds a BS in Media and Communication from the University of Sargodha, where he graduated in 2026.

He has a keen interest in journalism, news reporting and current affairs, and enjoys exploring social issues and explaining new developments clearly to the public. Through his academic projects he has built skills in research and writing, social media management and photography.
He hopes to grow as a journalist and contribute to responsible, informative storytelling.
